title: Good for uncooked dough.
text: Good for uncooked dough.. Product works well as a scraper, but the edge is dull and won't cut through a cooked dough bowl.  It is very well made and should last a long time.  It does work well for cutting through rolled out uncooked dough.  I really needed one that could cut through the cooked dough without squishing it flat.
